name: Big Game Hunter Rifle
body:
Price 10,300 gp; Aura moderate conjuration; CL 8th; Weight 15 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This +2 lever-action rifle was specially constructed to grant an extra 1d6 damage to creatures of a specific subtype (selected from the bane list during creation).

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 5,150 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells summon monster I
